conditions.description: Upload acceptance trusts the client-provided $_FILES file type beginning with image/.
conditions.rationale: Multipart Content-Type is attacker-controlled and does not establish the uploaded bytes are an image.

conditions.description: A user-controlled folder value is concatenated directly into the destination path.
conditions.rationale: Traversal segments can escape the intended uploads subdirectory unless separately normalized and confined.

conditions.description: The original client filename is stored under public/uploads without an extension allowlist or server-generated safe extension.
conditions.rationale: A spoofed image MIME type can be paired with an executable server-side extension and placed in a public path.

conditions.description: The entire temporary upload is read into memory before any application-level size bound is checked.
conditions.rationale: Large accepted uploads can consume process memory even though only emptiness is validated.

conditions.description: The handler checks for UPLOAD_ERR_OK before processing the file.
conditions.rationale: An inspector should not report that PHP upload status is ignored.

conditions.description: The handler uses move_uploaded_file for the final move.
conditions.rationale: The PHP upload-origin check provided by move_uploaded_file is present and should not be claimed absent.

conditions.description: Whether the web server executes PHP or another active content type from public/uploads is not established by this file.
conditions.rationale: Web-server handler configuration is external evidence.

conditions.description: The effective php.ini upload and request-size limits are not established by this handler.
conditions.rationale: Platform configuration may impose additional bounds but is absent from the fixture.

conditions.description: The endpoint must not be cleared as safely confining arbitrary user uploads.
conditions.rationale: Client MIME trust, user-controlled destination folders, and original filenames leave multiple confinement boundaries unresolved.

conditions.description: The upload path must not be cleared as resistant to active-content upload attacks.
conditions.rationale: Executable filename extensions are not rejected and server execution policy is unknown.
